```csharp
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerBehavioralTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync_ReturnsFalseOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerForTest();

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(null, new ReplicateSyncOptions
            {
                NodeId = 1,
                TryAddReplica = true,
                Force = false,
                UpgradeLock = false,
                Background = false
            });

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result.Success);
            Assert.True(result.ErrorMessage.Length > 0);
        }

        // Minimal test subclass to cause exception by null clusterProvider
        private class ReplicationManagerForTest : ReplicationManager
        {
            public ReplicationManagerForTest()
            {
                // Intentionally do not initialize clusterProvider to cause exception
            }
        }
    }

    // Minimal stub for ReplicateSyncOptions
    public class ReplicateSyncOptions
    {
        public long NodeId { get; set; }
        public bool TryAddReplica { get; set; }
        public bool Force { get; set; }
        public bool UpgradeLock { get; set; }
        public bool Background { get; set; }
    }
}
```
